🛑 Requirement: Scope this guidance to advanced-search-capable API calls

This is true for the default API search only when the host supports advanced issue search. On older GHES versions the searcher falls back to the legacy syntax, and `--web` always opens the legacy global search, where these operators and nesting are unsupported. As written, users on those paths are told that merely splitting the query into arguments enables functionality that the selected backend cannot parse.

🛑 Requirement: Do not claim pull-request searches lack advanced syntax

The default `gh search prs` path uses the same advanced issue-search REST backend as `gh search issues` and appends `type:pr`; the merged implementation in cli/cli#11638 explicitly verified `advanced_search=true` for this command. This text therefore directs users away from supported `AND`/`OR` and nested queries on github.com and GHES 3.18+, although `--web` and older hosts still use the legacy syntax.

🛑 Requirement: Link an eligible issue before proceeding

The PR does not identify an existing issue with both the `help wanted` label and explicit Acceptance Criteria. External pull requests are accepted only when that gate is met (`.github/CONTRIBUTING.md:5,15,19`), so the intended scope cannot currently be validated. Please obtain a qualifying issue or confirmed maintainer authorization before proceeding.

Issue: the list of host availability should be removed since this list is not exhaustive and it presents a maintenance burden where one day GHES 3.18 will be so old that it doesn't make sense to mention it, or someone complains we don't list GHEC with data residency here. This type of information about what platform features are available on what GitHub host versions is best left to the official GitHub docs website. 

```suggestion
			Boolean operators %[1]sOR%[1]s and %[1]sAND%[1]s, and parentheses for nesting, are supported
			on GitHub hosts with advanced issue search,
```

Sure — I modeled this after the existing wording in `item list`:

https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/9b031151a825bda919203c5202876a725d637368/pkg/cmd/project/item-list/item_list.go#L44-L46

But I agree that a fixed reference makes things harder to maintain. I'll remove as suggested 👍

```suggestion
			on GitHub hosts with advanced issue search,
```

Suggest: Somewhere around here I think there should be a link to https://docs.github.com/en/enterprise-cloud@latest/issues/tracking-your-work-with-issues/using-issues/filtering-and-searching-issues-and-pull-requests#building-advanced-filters-for-issues

Since we are talking about advanced search syntax, but note that `gh` doesn't actually produce this feature. It just sends the syntax to a GitHub host. If behavior changes here down the road, it won't be documented on our end necessarily; it'll be in the GitHub.com docs.
